say:0:1735303001:1.text: Sure. I'll have the refreshments ready for you shortly.
say:0:1735303001:1.source_cn: 好的，请稍等，这就为您准备茶点。
say:0:1735303001:1.male: Sure. I'll have the refreshments ready for you shortly.
say:0:1735303001:1.female: Sure. I'll have the refreshments ready for you shortly.

narration:1:1735303002:1.text: With a demure smile, the court maid returns with another tray of food. Once again, you polish it off in no time...
narration:1:1735303002:1.male: With a demure smile, the court maid returns with another tray of food. Once again, you polish it off in no time...
narration:1:1735303002:1.female: With a demure smile, the court maid returns with another tray of food. Once again, you polish it off in no time...

say:2:1735303003:1.text: Large plates pile up before you, yet strangely, your stomach still feels empty, as though you were under a hunger spell.
say:2:1735303003:1.source_cn: 你的面前叠着数个巨大的白瓷盘。但奇怪的是，你依旧感觉腹...
say:2:1735303003:1.male: Large plates pile up before you, yet strangely, your stomach still feels empty, as though you were under a hunger spell.
say:2:1735303003:1.female: Large plates pile up before you, yet strangely, your stomach still feels empty, as though you were under a hunger spell.

say:3:1735303004:1.text: Dura above, maybe that's the charm of royal confections.
say:3:1735303004:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这可能就是王室精致茶点的魅力所在。
